newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia sees closer ties with Hungary, Italy.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia sees closer ties with Hungary, Italy.

text.p: Slovenia's foreign ministry said on Wednesday a meeting of government representatives from Slovenia, Italy and Hungary marked the start of a broader cooperation between the three countries.
Ignac Golob, secretary at Slovenia's foreign ministry, met with his Italian counterpart Piero Fassino and Hungarian foreign ministry official Istvan Szentivanyi in Maribor, eastern Slovenia.
"Today is the start of a three-sided cooperation between Slovenia, Italy and Hungary," Slovenian foreign ministry spokesman Alfonz Naberznik told Reuters.
He said the three countries planned to work together in defence, transport, economics and culture.
The three secretaries also prepared for a meeting of their foreign ministers on October 23 in Rome.
"Today's meeting confirmed good Slovenian relations with Italy and Hungary," Naberznik said.
Slovenia and Hungary both hope to be in the first group of countries that will enlarge the 16-member NATO pact.
They are also front-runners for full membership in the European Union and are among 10 former communist states that have signed an association agreement with the bloc.
